summary: Frontend-only re-test of RMJ One (mobile 390x844). All 10 requested flows pass end-to-end: login (both invalid + valid), full Dashboard render (6 attendance tiles + 4 approvals + 5 payroll tiles), bottom-tab navigation Dashboard↔Employees↔Settings, employee list with 5 seeded rows, chip filters (all/active/on_leave/inactive) + search, employee profile with Timeline/Details/Payroll tabs, FAB add-employee (auto code) returns to list with new row, edit → salary change → 'Salary Revised' timeline event with 'From ₹28000 to ₹30500' captured on-screen, and Settings logout returning to /login. No red-screens, no failed API calls. Login testID rename from iteration 1 is verified. Minor RN deprecation warnings noted (shadow*, pointerEvents) — non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/employees.tsx:257 (shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset)

Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/employee/new.tsx:188 (<LinearGradient ... pointerEvents="none" />) — move to style.pointerEvents

action_items: Optional: migrate shadow* props to boxShadow on the FAB (employees.tsx) to silence RN-web deprecation warning.
Optional: move pointerEvents="none" from the LinearGradient prop into its style prop in employee/new.tsx to silence RN deprecation warning.
No functional fixes required — Milestone 1 MVP frontend is green.
critical_code_review_comments: employee/new.tsx handles both create and edit via useLocalSearchParams — clean, but note that edit route re-exports via /employee/edit/[id].tsx. Works as expected.
Dashboard useFocusEffect+load pattern refetches on every focus which is correct for reflecting new employees after add.
All interactive elements have testID coverage; login screen testIDs now match the tester convention (login-username/password/submit/error).
seed_data_creation: One TEST employee was created via the FAB during the test (auto-generated code). Not cleaned up — safe (prefixed 'TEST User <ts>'). Main agent can leave or delete via UI.
